name: desafio-qa-automacao
description: Projeto de automação QA - API (Postman/Newman) e UI (Cypress + BDD Cucumber) para o e-commerce Demoblaze
author: Bruna Karoline Ferraz

scripts.test:api: newman run postman/demoblaze_api_collection.json -e postman/demoblaze_environment.json --delay-request 300 --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman/api-report.html
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test
